title: Hearing on Mayor's Executive Order 13 immigration audit report
summary: The Council's Immigration Committee held an oversight hearing examining the report of audit findings and recommendations issued under Executive Order 13 of 2026. Testimony was invited from the Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs, immigration service providers and advocacy groups amid heightened federal immigration enforcement in New York City. The committee also heard Resolution 626 urging Congress and the President to grant Haiti Temporary Protected Status.
